Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Represents an individual construction or renovation expense (Material or Mão de Obra).

description.description: Description of the expense item or work performed

category.description: Category of the expense: Material or Mão de Obra

date.description: Date formatted as DD/MM/YYYY or ISO timestamp

receiptUrl.description: Optional base64 image or URL of receipt/voucher

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

obraId.description: Identifier of the construction project (obra) this expense belongs to

Obra.title: Obra
Obra.description: Represents a construction project or site managed by the user.

name.description: Name or location of the construction project

budgetLimit.description: Optional budget ceiling for this specific obra

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile document storing basic account preferences.

/users/{userId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Subcollection of expenses belonging strictly to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/obras/{obraId}.description: Subcollection of construction projects/obras belonging strictly to the authenticated user.
